title: The Slow Snail
lines: Rain fell all day and made a big mess.
Tim and Mom went to see the long wet road.
A small snail sat in the road.
It was slow, and a truck might come.
Tim set it by a big green leaf.
The snail slid up to reach the leaf.
It went so slow! Tim sat with Mom to see it.
A gray crow came to pick at the snail.
The yell did not make the crow go.
Then Tim held up his big red hat.
The crow left, and the snail ate its leaf.

questions.ask: Why did Tim move the snail off the road?
questions.listenFor: It was slow and a truck might come.

questions.ask: What made the crow go away?
questions.listenFor: Tim held up his big red hat. The yell alone had not worked.

questions.ask: A yell did not move the crow, but a red hat did. What else might have worked?
questions.listenFor: Any idea. Lines nine to eleven hold both tries. Ask what makes a bird go off.
